entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.>> Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into the depths of waters, and the flood overfloweth me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am weary with my crying, my throat is parched; mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: Thou, O God, knowest my foolishness, and my trespasses are not hidden from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Let not them that wait on thee, Lord, Jehovah of hosts, be ashamed through me; let not those that seek thee be confounded through me, O God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; confusion hath covered my face.

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's sons;

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: For the zeal of thy house hath devoured me, and the reproaches of them that reproach thee have fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: And I wept, my soul was fasting: that also was to my reproach; --

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: And I made sackcloth my garment: then I became a proverb to them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: They that sit in the gate talk of me, and [I am] the song of the drunkards.

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: ¶But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy loving-kindness answer me, according to the truth of thy salvation:

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Deliver me out of the mire, let me not sink; let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the depths of waters.

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Let not the flood of waters overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up; and let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy loving-kindness is good: according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, turn toward me;

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: And hide not thy face from thy servant, for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Draw nigh unto my soul, be its redeemer; ransom me because of mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: *Thou* knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: Reproach hath broken my heart, and I am overwhelmed: and I looked for sympathy, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: Yea, they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: ¶Let their table become a snare before them, and their very welfare a trap;

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not, and make their loins continually to shake.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let the fierceness of thine anger take hold of them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Let their habitation be desolate; let there be no dweller in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: For they persecute him whom *thou* hast smitten, and they talk for the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Add iniquity unto their iniquity, and let them not come into thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I am afflicted and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me secure on high.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: ¶I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving;

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: And it shall please Jehovah more than an ox, --a bullock with horns and cloven hoofs.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The meek shall see it, they shall be glad; ye that seek God, your heart shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For Jehovah heareth the needy, and despiseth not his prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let heavens and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moveth therein.

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah; and they shall dwell there, and possess it:

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: And the seed of his servants shall inherit it, and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
